# Version 4.150.2
> **Ganesh and shader reliability** · Released August 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.2/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.2 improves GPU failure handling and fixes a SkSL raster-pipeline lifetime error.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **GPU flush and readback correctness** — Prevents stale readbacks after failed flushes, restores resolve dirty tracking when a task does not execute, and includes the Imagination framebuffer-deletion workaround. ([#4517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4517), [#4561](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4561))
- **SkSL raster-pipeline lifetime** — Fixes an upstream use-after-free in raster-pipeline code generation. ([#4663](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4663))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.2

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
